title: Cartwise+ Membership Entry Requirements and Free Trials by Plan
content:
Cartwise+ Membership plans differ in the proof of eligibility they require, the length of the free trial granted at enrollment and the limits on who may receive a trial. The per-plan values are:

| Plan | Proof required before start | Days to have proof accepted | Proof re-accepted every | Free trial (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | SNAP EBT card | 7 | 12 months | 30 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | student email address | 7 | 12 months | 30 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | none | 0 (no proof required) | 0 (never) | 14 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | none | 0 (no proof required) | 0 (never) | 14 |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | none | 0 (no proof required) | 0 (never) | 14 |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | none | 0 (no proof required) | 0 (never) | 0 (no trial) |

| Plan | Minimum age of the account holder | Trial re-eligibility gap after a canceled membership | Lifetime trials per customer profile | Maximum cumulative years on the student plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 18 years | 365 days | 2 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 18 years | 365 days | 2 | 4 years |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 18 years | 365 days | 2 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 18 years | 365 days | 2 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | 18 years | 365 days | 2 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 18 years | 365 days | 2 | 0 (not applicable) |

## What each column means

- **Proof required before start**: the proof the plan requires before the membership can start.
- **Days to have proof accepted**: the number of calendar days after enrollment within which the required proof must be accepted; 0 means no proof is required.
- **Proof re-accepted every**: how often, in calendar months, the proof must be accepted again to keep the plan; 0 means never.
- **Free trial**: the length in calendar days of the free trial granted at enrollment; 0 means the plan has no trial.
- **Trial re-eligibility gap**: a customer whose previous membership was canceled fewer than this many days ago gets no trial.
- **Lifetime trials per customer profile**: the maximum number of trials one customer profile may ever receive, counted across all plans.
- **Maximum cumulative years on the student plan**: the ceiling on total time on Cartwise+ Student Monthly; 0 means the limit does not apply to that plan.
